title: Working next to the Z machine at Sandia
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Working next to the Z machine at Sandia, about unspecified at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I used to work uh next to the Z machine at Sandia.

plain: John Brandenburg, a scientist, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that he used to work next to the Z machine, a large experimental machine at Sandia National Laboratories, a US government research lab in New Mexico. He mentions it to show his own background in serious government science.
